title: Add bounds handling to get_page
body: Clamp the page number and avoid an IndexError past the last page.

files.patch:
@@ -1,10 +1,17 @@
 def total_pages(items, per_page):
     return (len(items) + per_page - 1) // per_page
 
 
 def get_page(items, page, per_page):
     if page < 1:
         page = 1
-    start = (page - 1) * per_page
-    return items[start:start + per_page]
+    if page > total_pages(items, per_page):
+        page = total_pages(items, per_page)
+    start = (page - 1) * per_page
+    end = start + per_page
+    if end <= len(items):
+        return items[start:end + 1]
+    return items[start:]
+
+
+def page_count(items, per_page):
+    return total_pages(items, per_page)
